intro: Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan takes the Violet Powder to mix into the dew, and asks you to come back to him in a moment, once his fabulous elixir is perfected.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now, to mix this powder in with the dew.
Come back and talk to me in a minute... After I have perfected the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I knew I had it in me... Oh thanks again, friend for your help, but please, stand a little to the side, will you? You're blocking my business! I'm going to make millions on the fabulous Noggenfogger Elixir, millions!
What's that? Sprinkle says I owe her a favor? Oh, that Sprinkle, such a kidder!
